name: Hainan Strait Shipping Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hainan Strait Shipping Co.,Ltd. provides shipping and ferry port services in China. The company operates passenger, vehicle, and roll-on/roll-off ferry routes. It also engages in business services; loading, unloading, and warehousing services; ship vessel leasing; machinery and equipment operation and leasing; and commercial service activities. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Haikou, China. Hainan Strait Shipping Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Hainan Port and Waterway Holding Co., Ltd.
